body:
NPS and LG AI Research Institute plan to develop AI-based exchange rate analysis, and conduct joint research on applying the technology to investment operational tasks.

Korean pension giant National Pension Service (NPS) and the artificial intelligence unit of local conglomerate LG Group have signed a pact to team up to develop AI for fund management.

Their first project will be AI-based exchange rate analysis services tailored for fund management that will integrate the LG AI Research Institute’s techniques with macroeconomic indicators and research data to analyse exchange rate fluctuations, the NPS says in a statement on September 11.

The deal also calls for them to conduct joint research on applying AI to investment operational tasks, as well as focus on strengthening the pension fund’s utilisation of the technology through educational programmes and external consultations.

“Through this agreement, we will systematically verify the application and potential of artificial intelligence technology in actual work,” Seo Won-joo, chief investment officer at NPS, is quoted as saying in the statement. “Starting with exchange rate analysis, we will continuously identify new areas for artificial intelligence application to improve operational efficiency, fostering an environment focused on fund management.”

The NPS is the world’s third largest pension fund with 1,848 trillion won (US$1.37 trillion) of assets.
